items.reason: A rinse-off wash that targets the look of breakouts and stays on the skin only briefly.
A fragrance-free ceramide moisturizer to offset dryness from a benzoyl peroxide wash.
A mineral SPF 50 for daily protection, and a gentle choice for a pregnancy routine.

response.routine_note: Use the wash once a day at first, work up slowly if your skin is comfortable, then follow with moisturizer, and SPF in the morning. I left out retinoids and strong peels because they are not suited to pregnancy, so please ask your prenatal provider or a dermatologist about the breakouts if they persist or feel painful.
